mapper.select: SELECT table.id AS table_id, table.user_id AS table_user_id, table.date, block.id AS block_id, block.user_id AS block_user_id, block.table_id AS block_table_id, block.title AS block_title, block.status, block.width, block.start_at, block.color, task.id AS task_id, task.time_block_id AS task_block_id, task.title AS task_title, schedule.id AS schedule_id, schedule.user_id AS schedule_user_id, schedule.kind, schedule.start_at, schedule.end_at, schedule.start_date, schedule.end_date, schedule.title AS schedule_title FROM time_tables table LEFT JOIN time_blocks block ON table.id = block.table_id LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks task ON block.id = task.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule schedule ON block.schedule_id = schedule.id WHERE (table_user_id = #{userId}) AND (table.date = #{date})
mapper.update: UPDATE time_tables SET date = #{date} WHERE id = #{id}
